textConstants.depthConverterWarning: This calculator uses simple depth conversion (where 1 ATM = 1 bar), so the values shown here are less precise, than in rest of the application. Also it uses ideal gas law, so the calculated Rmv is lower then in reality.

about.title: About Gas Planner
about.tagline1: Open source Scuba diving application to help divers plan their dives.
about.tagline2: Plan your dive and dive your plan!
about.disclaimerText: None of the authors, contributors, administrators, or anyone else connected with this project can be responsible for your use of the information provided by this application or linked from these web pages. Use the results at your own risk.

diff.onlyOneDive: There is only one dive planned. If you want to compare dives, define at least two.

gasBlender.unableToCalculateMessage: Unable to calculate the required mix, because the Top mix contains more oxygen or helium, than target mix.

gasProps.minimumDepthWarningMessage: Exceeded minimum value of Oxygen partial pressure ({{minPpO2}}), which defines minimum depth. Add more oxygen content or reduce required depth.
gasProps.maximumDepthWarningMessage: Exceeded maximum value of Oxygen partial pressure ({{maxPpO2}}). Increase the maximum ppO2, reduce oxygen content or reduce required depth.
gasProps.mndWarningMessage: Exceeded maximum value of narcotic depth ({{mndLimit}} {{unit}}) controlled by partial pressure of toxic parts (oxygen and nitrogen). Reduce nitrogen content by adding helium, adding oxygen or reduce required depth.
gasProps.densityWarningMessage: Exceeded maximum value of gas density ({{maxDensity}} {{unit}}). Reduce oxygen content or add more helium.

ndlLimits.noResultsMessageLine1: No NDL limits found in meaningful depth range.

nitrox.lowModMessage: Too small final operation depth. Increase ppO2 or reduce Percent O2.

diveIssues.calculationError: There was an error while calculating profile.
diveIssues.notEnoughTimePrefix: Not enough time to realize the dive (duration needs to be at least
diveIssues.notEnoughTimeSuffix: min)! Set longer planed dive time.
diveIssues.notEnoughGasPrefix: Not enough gas to realize the dive! Maximum bottom time for current amount of gas is
diveIssues.notEnoughGasSuffix: min. Use larger tank, fill it with more gas, reduce dive duration or planned depth.
diveIssues.notEnoughGasShort: Not enough gas to realize the dive! Maximum bottom time for current amount of gas is shorter than currently planned dive. Use larger tank, fill it with more gas, reduce dive duration or planned depth.
diveIssues.brokenCeiling: Exceeded minimum safe (ceiling) depth! Change your plan to higher depth at this point.
diveIssues.lowPpo2: Reached low partial pressure of oxygen (minimum depth exceeded)! There is a risk of hypoxia. Use gas with higher oxygen content.
diveIssues.highPpo2: Reached high partial pressure of oxygen (maximum depth exceeded)! There is a risk of oxygen toxicity. Reduce the depth or use gas with lower oxygen content.
diveIssues.highDescentSpeed: High descent speed! Descent longer time or descent to lower depth.
diveIssues.highAscentSpeed: High ascent speed! Ascent to higher depth only or ascent longer time.
diveIssues.highN2Switch: Gas switch to gas with higher nitrogen content is not recommended! There is a risk od isobaric counter diffusion (IDC). Switch to another gas with higher helium content or lower nitrogen content.
diveIssues.mndExceeded: Exceeded maximum narcotic depth for selected gas! Reduce the depth or use gas with higher helium content.
diveIssues.highDensity: Exceeded maximum recommended gas density! Reduce the depth or use gas with higher helium content (i.e. lower density).
diveIssues.minDepth: Dives planned to shallow depth for long time may lead to saturation diving! Reduce the dive duration shorter than 5 hours.
diveIssues.maxDepth: Exceeded maximum depth where the algorithm was well tested on real life data! Reduce the maximum depth.
diveIssues.missingAirbreak: It is recommended to don't breath pure oxygen longer than 20 minutes. Use air break option to generate proper gas switches or manually add switch to bottom gas.
diveIssues.noDecoPrefix: No decompression time for current depth exceeded (For no decompression dive set dive time maximum to
diveIssues.otuExceededPrefix: Exceeded 80 % of maximum single exposure oxygen toxicity units
diveIssues.otuExceededSuffix: There is a high risk of lungs injury. Reduce amount of oxygen in your gases, dive duration or target depths.
diveIssues.cnsExceededPrefix: Exceeded 80 % of maximum single exposure oxygen toxicity
diveIssues.cnsExceededSuffix: There is a high risk of CNS injury. Reduce amount of oxygen in your gases, dive duration or target depths.

questions.examples_depth: What is the depth (in meters) at which the ambient pressure is {pressure} bar?
questions.examples_pressure: What is the ambient pressure in bars at depth {depth} meters?
questions.examples_mod: What is maximum operational depth for gas with {o2_percent} % oxygen at partial pressure {pp} ?
questions.examples_bestmix: What is best mix (in percents) at partial pressure {pp} at depth {depth} m?
questions.examples_ppO2: What is partial pressure of {o2_percent} % at {depth} m?
questions.examples_ead: What is the equivalent air depth of nitrox mix with {o2_percent} % oxygen at {depth} m?
questions.examples_sac: My respiratory minute volume (RMV in liters per minute) is {rmv} L/min. What is my surface air consumption (SAC) when breathing from {tank_size} L tank?
questions.examples_rmv: What is respiratory minute volume (RMV in liters per minute) of dive to average depth {depth} m, with tank {tank_size} L for {duration} minutes where diver consumed {consumed} b?
questions.examples_consumed: How much gas did i use (in bars) at average depth {depth} m, with tank {tank_size} L for {duration} minutes where my respiratory minute volume (RMV) was {rmv} L/min?
questions.examples_durationbyrmv: How long can i stay (in minutes) at average depth {depth} m with available {consumed} b in {tank_size} L tank, where my respiratory minute volume (RMV) is {rmv} L/min?
questions.examples_mindepth: Team selects Trimix {oxygen}/{helium} as a gas for a dive. Minimum partial pressure of oxygen (ppO2) is 0.18 b. What is the minimum depth for this gas?
questions.examples_end: You plan a dive to {depth} meters. Oxygen is considered as narcotic. Team selects Trimix {oxygen}/{helium} as a gas for the dive. What is the equivalent narcotic depth for this gas?
questions.examples_mnd: You plan a dive and consider Air narcotic for depths below {narc_depth} meters. Oxygen is considered as narcotic. Team selects Trimix {oxygen}/{helium} as a gas. What is the maximum narcotic depth for this gas?
